items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: It was Woody Herman, but he was a clarinet player.

ctx.x: Yeah, when he was the second time I went there. So he was with Fletcher. Boy Heather made a band there. I think it's Woody something.
I don't know. It was Woody Herman, but he was a clarinet player. No, no, no.
